rules.statement: A pupil is considered a privy of his tutor and cannot re-agitate questions decided in an earlier action involving the tutor, provided the pupil claims under the same title as the tutor.
rules.supporting_quote: "Now although an incumbency is an office, I have tried to show in my judgment in Podiya v. Bumangala Thero (supra) that it is an office to which rights in property attach; and for that reason I think the principle of res judicata would apply."
